top_findings: 97% of indexable URLs (44 course pages + 26 tutor profiles) are severely templated, thin content (136-210 words) - the primary blocker to ranking 100+ keywords
Sitewide Core Web Vitals failure: homepage Total Blocking Time 6.3s, Time to Interactive 19.6s on mobile, caused by a single shared JS component doing forced-synchronous-layout
Course pages are the wrong page type for their target keywords - Google rewards Service/Hybrid or marketplace-grid pages, TutorA ships thin product listings
Homepage trust stats ('1,200+ verified tutors') render as literal '0' to non-JS crawlers/AI systems - confirmed independently by 2 specialist audits
Course pages show '4.8 star' ratings with zero backing reviews - a falsifiable trust claim, also a schema manual-action risk if AggregateRating is ever added to match it
quick_wins: Server-render real trust-stat numbers instead of '0' (one component fix)
Suppress star-rating badge when review count is 0
Remove deprecated HowTo schema block from homepage
Add rel=nofollow to /admin and /dashboard footer links (present on every page, disallowed in robots.txt)
Add logo and sameAs to Organization schema
Fix broken template splice on Python course page
Publish a public /become-a-tutor recruiting landing page

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Valid, correctly-declared sitemap (71 URLs)
Clean self-canonicalizing URLs including query-filtered pages
Correct protocol/host redirect consolidation
Full modern security-header suite sitewide
100% server-rendered content, zero console errors
Fast TTFB (120-480ms), lightweight Brotli-compressed pages (9-36KB)

findings.title: Auth-gated /admin and /dashboard links present in footer of every page while disallowed in robots.txt
findings.description: Every sampled page's server-rendered footer links to /admin and /dashboard, both Disallow'd in robots.txt - a sitewide crawl-budget waste pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add rel=nofollow, or render only after client-side auth hydration, or replace with a JS onClick router push.

findings.title: 66 of 71 pages missing og:image and page-specific Twitter Card metadata
findings.description: Course and tutor pages have og:title/description populated but no og:image, and Twitter Card falls back to generic homepage copy.
findings.recommendation: Extend the homepage's opengraph-image route pattern with [slug] params for course/tutor templates.

findings.title: /courses hub ItemList schema mislabels category filters as Course entities
findings.description: 5 category-filter links are typed as schema.org Course when they are filter URLs, not bookable courses.
findings.recommendation: Retype as CollectionPage/WebPage/Thing, reserve Course typing for the 44 real course-detail pages.

findings.title: CSP allows unsafe-inline for scripts and styles
findings.description: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' undercuts CSP's XSS protection.
findings.recommendation: Adopt Next.js middleware-based CSP nonce pattern.

findings.title: No public, indexable tutor-recruitment landing page
findings.description: /become-a-tutor correctly redirects to /login and is disallowed, but no public page anywhere pitches tutor recruitment.
findings.recommendation: Publish a public landing page for the tutor-recruitment funnel, keep the application flow gated behind login.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod timestamps cluster in generation-order windows, not genuine edit dates
findings.description: 64 course/tutor lastmod values sit in two ~10-minute sequential windows, suggesting seed timestamps rather than real content changes.
findings.recommendation: Tie lastmod to genuine content-revision events.

findings.title: Organization schema missing logo and sameAs
findings.description: Only name/url/description present.
findings.recommendation: Add logo and verified social profile sameAs links.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage carries genuine, valid JSON-LD (7 schema blocks)
Clear, coherent value proposition copy
Legitimate vetting-process claims (ID check, background check, video interview)
Tutor cards contain concrete, specific data points
Course pages have a consistent, scannable UX scaffold

findings.title: All sampled course pages share one verbatim trust sentence and near-identical 136-155 word template
findings.description: 10 sampled course pages across dance, guitar, design, language, test-prep, and coding categories all use the exact same sentence skeleton with only nouns swapped, including a word-for-word repeated trust sentence.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with subject-specific depth: real syllabus, example lesson structure, prerequisite guidance - target 300-400+ unique words per page.

findings.title: Tutor profile pages restate the same 3 facts twice in ~75 words
findings.description: All 6 sampled tutor profiles use an identical 3-clause template that repeats name/subjects/years within the same short page.
findings.recommendation: Add genuine differentiating content: headshot, teaching philosophy, credentials, sample lesson video, real reviews.

findings.title: Star ratings shown with zero reviews
findings.description: Every sampled course page shows '4.8 (0)' or '5.0 (0)' - a precise rating with no reviews backing it.
findings.recommendation: Suppress rating display until real reviews exist; show 'No reviews yet'.

findings.title: Homepage trust statistics render as literal 0 in crawlable HTML
findings.description: JS count-up animation with no server-rendered fallback value means non-JS crawlers see '0 verified tutors, 0 successful matches'.
findings.recommendation: Server-render actual numeric values, layer animation as progressive enhancement.

findings.title: About page lacks named accountability/authorship signals
findings.description: 215 words, no founder/team names, no company history, no address, despite the page being central to the platform's 'personally vetted' trust claim.
findings.recommendation: Add named team members with bios, credentials, photos, company history.

findings.title: Tutor pages don't surface the 4-checkmark vetting claims made on the homepage
findings.description: The homepage's core differentiator (ID verification, background check, video interview) isn't shown on the page where trust actually needs to be proven.
findings.recommendation: Surface verification badges directly on tutor profile pages.

findings.title: Broken template splice on Python course page
findings.description: Literal unedited fragment: 'you'll be able to python Programming for Beginners'.
findings.recommendation: Manually review all 44 course pages for similar template-splicing errors.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique, well-formed titles and meta descriptions per page/template

findings.title: /find-a-tutor has no H2 heading structure below H1
findings.description: Only one H3 exists on the page; no 'how it works' section, no structural hierarchy.
findings.recommendation: Add proper H2-led sections including an aggregate trust-stat bar and how-matching-works explainer.

findings.title: Course pages lack FAQ/comparison/objection-handling content
findings.description: Competing pages in the same SERPs dedicate FAQ sections to guarantees, trial terms, and scheduling.
findings.recommendation: Add a 3-5 item FAQ block per course page with FAQPage schema.

findings.title: Duplicate anchor links per tutor card on /find-a-tutor
findings.description: Each tutor's profile link is repeated once per subject tag, inflating boilerplate and diluting internal-link signal.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate multi-subject tutors into a single card with subject tags.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: JSON-LD used exclusively, correct schema.org context, absolute URLs
Valid Organization, WebSite, Course (with offers), Person (with knowsAbout/worksFor), BreadcrumbList
No fabricated/placeholder values found anywhere sampled

findings.title: Deprecated HowTo schema on homepage
findings.description: Google removed HowTo rich results in September 2023; this block provides zero SERP benefit.
findings.recommendation: Remove entirely, or replace with a plain ItemList if structural markup is still wanted.

findings.title: Organization schema missing logo and sameAs
findings.description: Blocks Knowledge Panel eligibility and entity-graph consolidation.
findings.recommendation: Add logo (>=112x112px) and sameAs social profile links.

findings.title: Course schema missing recommended hasCourseInstance
findings.description: Duration and mode data already shown on-page isn't reflected in schema.
findings.recommendation: Add hasCourseInstance with courseMode/courseWorkload.

findings.title: Do not add AggregateRating until real reviews exist
findings.description: On-page rating displays '4.8 (0)' - adding matching schema would violate Google's non-genuine-review policy.
findings.recommendation: Fix the front-end display first; only add AggregateRating once ratingCount >= 1.

findings.title: BreadcrumbList missing on /about
findings.description: Course/tutor pages have correct 3-level breadcrumbs; /about has none.
findings.recommendation: Add a 2-level breadcrumb to /about.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: CLS excellent sitewide (0-0.012)
Fast TTFB (~30ms server time)
Light total page weight (480-508KB) across all templates
Zero image-weight risk - no image bytes loaded anywhere

findings.title: Severe main-thread blocking from forced synchronous layout, sitewide
findings.description: Two shared JS chunks cause forced reflows on every page tested, driving homepage Total Blocking Time to 6,340ms and Time to Interactive to 19.6s on mobile lab tests.
findings.recommendation: Identify the shared scroll-reveal/animation component; replace synchronous DOM geometry reads with IntersectionObserver or CSS-only animation.

findings.title: LCP dominated by render delay, not network
findings.description: 92-96% of total LCP time is render delay across all four pages tested - main thread too busy to paint content that's already downloaded.
findings.recommendation: Fixing the forced-reflow issue should resolve most of this; audit script evaluation cost of the two large chunks.

findings.title: Total Blocking Time fails Poor threshold on all four pages tested
findings.description: 6,340ms on homepage down to 810ms on the lightest course-detail page, all exceeding the 500ms Poor INP threshold by a wide margin.
findings.recommendation: Break up long tasks, defer/lazy-hydrate below-the-fold sections.

findings.title: Excessive DOM size on /find-a-tutor (4,544 elements)
findings.description: Nearly 3x the 1,500-element guideline, compounding the reflow cost from the animation issue.
findings.recommendation: Paginate or virtualize the tutor card list.

findings.title: Render-blocking CSS with no font preload hints on hub pages
findings.description: 13.6KB CSS chunk blocks render on home/courses/find-a-tutor; three woff2 fonts (~120KB total) load without preload hints.
findings.recommendation: Preload above-the-fold fonts, inline critical CSS.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Homepage and About open with direct, self-contained, LLM-extractable definitions
Course pages land almost exactly in the ideal 134-167 word citation range
Fully server-rendered - non-JS AI crawlers see full content
robots.txt permissively allows all AI crawlers via wildcard

findings.title: Headline trust statistics render as 0 for non-JS AI crawlers
findings.description: Confirmed via both raw curl and Playwright render diffing - the site's strongest citable proof-point block is currently invisible to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the actual numeric values as visible text nodes.

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: Returns 404. ChatGPT and Perplexity crawlers reportedly consult it where present.
findings.recommendation: Publish a concise llms.txt listing key pages and a summary of the vetting/matching model.

findings.title: Zero images anywhere on the site
findings.description: No tutor headshots, no course thumbnails, no video - nothing for multimodal answer engines to surface.
findings.recommendation: Add tutor profile photos and course thumbnail images with descriptive alt text.

findings.title: No entity/brand signals off-page or in schema
findings.description: No sameAs, no social links, no named founder, zero YouTube presence (the strongest brand-citation correlator per GEO research).
findings.recommendation: Add sameAs links, visible footer social links, named founder with Person schema.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Confirmed absence keeps page weight low and CLS excellent

findings.title: Zero elements found anywhere on the site
findings.description: Independently confirmed by four separate specialist audits (Technical, Content, Performance, GEO). All visuals are CSS-drawn gradients or initials-only avatars - no tutor photos, no course images.
findings.recommendation: Add real tutor profile photos and course thumbnails with descriptive alt text, using next/image to preserve current performance profile.
